fieldValues.title: What may a dream change unattended in the programme?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised in Research (Dreamtime), 2026-10-30, as a question to explore before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Nothing: dreams propose, and a session decides.
- B. Its own layer only: clusters, overviews, confidence and placement, never vignettes, decisions or the human tip.
- C. What srs-context's dreams may change (decision 475a40e7), with structural redesigns brought as pull requests (vignette ac5974c6).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: What went wrong when agents changed programme records unattended, and what the owner wants to see before a change lands.
fieldValues.next_action: List the unattended changes to the programme in the last month and how many were reverted.
